SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE C. & S. B. REGISTRY File No. D. 3/20 Special Branch. Date. 14 / 8 / 38）

Subject (in full) Movements of Jaques Karp.

Made by D.S.Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by （签名）

With reference to the Officer i/c Special Branch memo
of July 23, 1932 regarding the whereabouts and present
activities of Jaques Karp, Latvian, inquiries made show that
he has not yet returned to Shanghai. Nothing is known
regarding his movements by the local Latvian representative.
It is reported that his brother one John Karn employed as an
engineer with the China Merchants Steam Navigation Company
and who resides at No.129 Avenue Haig, ap.39, is not expecting
his arrival in the near future. Jaques Karp during his
sojourns in Shanghai usually resides at his brother's house.
Should J. Karp arrived in Shanghai or any information
regarding his activities be obtained a report will be duly
submitted.

（签名：D. S. Tcheremshansky）
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 雅克·卡尔普（Jaques Karp）的行踪。

制作人 D.S.切列姆尚斯基（D.S.Tcheremshansky）。转发人 （签名）

兹参照特别分支主管警官于1932年7月23日发出的关于拉脱维亚人雅克·卡尔普（Jaques Karp）的下落及目前活动的备忘录，经查询显示，他尚未返回上海。当地拉脱维亚代表对其行踪一无所知。据报，其兄约翰·卡恩（John Karn）受雇于轮船招商局担任工程师，居住在海格路129号39室，并不预期他在近期抵达。雅克·卡尔普在上海逗留期间，通常居住在其兄家中。若J.卡尔普抵达上海或获得有关其活动的任何信息，将按规定提交报告。

（签名：D. S. Tcheremshansky）
D. S.

特别分支主管警官。

（印：归档 E MS 1938年8月14日。）

July 20, 1932.

On the 11th June this year a Latvian named
Jacques Karp who was born at Riga on the 26th.11.08
was granted a single journey visa for the United
Kingdom. He stated that he wished to visit Mr.
Maurice Meyer, Palace Chambers, Bridge Street, Westminster,
S.W.1., to whom he acts as agent in the Far East.
An examination of correspondence in Karp's
possession revealed that he had the address of the
Liege United Armies Company, 22 rue Frappe, Liege,
with whom he stated he did business in sporting rifles.
Karp stated that he was importing these rifles into
Hongkong and Shanghai for sporting purposes, but when
further questioned stated that he intended to import arms
into Singapore. He stated that he intended proceeding
to Singapore in the near future and that he was eventually
taking up residence at Hongkong.
It is quite possible that this man may be
working as an agent for certain parties interested in
the smuggling of arms to the Far East and in the event
of his arriving in port I shall be glad to receive
information as to his activities.

S.I.
For arrangement in
co-operation with Landing - House
Section and report please.
M.
S.I. take note and
arrange with p.p. oic. P.S.B. 23:7:32.
confidentially. R 23/7

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处 刑事与特别分支登记处 编号 D 3/20 日期 1932年7月23日）
1932年7月20日。

今年6月11日，一名出生于1908年11月26日、里加籍的拉脱维亚人雅克·卡尔普（Jacques Karp）获发前往英国的单次旅行签证。他声称希望拜访位于威斯敏斯特桥街宫殿公寓（Palace Chambers, Bridge Street, Westminster, S.W.1.）的莫里斯·迈耶先生（Mr. Maurice Meyer），他是迈耶先生在远东的代理人。
对卡尔普所持信件的检查显示，他拥有比利时列日弗拉佩街22号（22 rue Frappe, Liege）的列日联合军火公司（Liege United Armies Company）的地址，并称该公司与其有运动步枪方面的业务往来。卡尔普称他将这些步枪进口至香港和上海用于运动目的，但在进一步询问下，他称打算将武器进口到新加坡。他表示打算在不久的将来前往新加坡，并最终在香港定居。
此人完全有可能作为某些对向远东走私武器感兴趣的当事人的代理人行事，若其抵港，我将很高兴收到有关其活动的情报。

S.I.
请安排与登陆房屋组（Landing - House Section）合作并具报。
M.
S.I. 知悉并与警务处特别分支主管警官协调安排。1932年7月23日。
机密。 R 23/7

Date January 29, 1932.

Subject (in full) Jacques Karp.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature] 01

With reference to the letter of January 19, 1932, from
the Netherlands Consulate-General regarding Jacques Karp his
identity and record as known to Municipal Police are as follows:-
Jacques Karp native of Latvia was born in Riga in 1888.
He is married and his wife and two children are residing in
Belgium. He received his education in the Moscow conservatory
and later at Milan, where he subsequently became an opera singer.
In 1918 he visited Shanghai and resided in this city about
six months during which time he gave two concerts. From
Shanghai he proceeded to Japan and Java for the purpose of giving
concerts. In Java he appears to have left the stage and
established himself as an import and export merchant. This
venture subsequently proved a failure and after being employed
with an export firm for a short period he left Java and returned
to Europe.
Karp is reported to have returned to Shanghai during the
Autumn of 1930. On October 17, 1930, he was engaged with the
Shanghai Telephone Company, as a mechanic. In his application
for employment with this concern he stated that he formerly
worked for the Bell Telephone Company in Antwerp. On October 16,
1926, he was transferred to the company's branch in Madrid.
At this place he remained until November 1929 when he was sent
to another branch at Zurich. During the ensuring year he was
transferred to the office in Rio de Janeiro. Here he remained
until July 19, 1930, when he severed connections with this
concern.
On November 11, 1931 he resigned from the Shanghai
Telephone Company as he was not satisfied with his wages, which
amounted to $350. Shortly afterwards he established himself as

主题（全称） 雅克·卡尔普（Jacques Karp）。

制作人 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（D.S. Tcheremshansky）。转发人 [签名] 01

兹参照荷兰总领事馆1932年1月19日来函，关于雅克·卡尔普，工部局警务处所知的其身份及履历如下：-
雅克·卡尔普系拉脱维亚人，1888年生于里加。
已婚，其妻及两名子女居住在比利时。他曾就读于莫斯科音乐学院，后在米兰求学，随后成为歌剧演唱家。
1918年他访问上海，在该市居住约六个月，期间举办了两场音乐会。从上海他前往日本和爪哇举办音乐会。在爪哇，他似乎离开了舞台，成为一名进出口商人。这项生意后来证明是失败的，在一家出口公司短暂受雇后，他离开爪哇返回欧洲。
据报卡尔普于1930年秋季返回上海。1930年10月17日，他被上海电话公司聘为技工。在向该公司求职时，他声称此前曾在安特卫普的贝尔电话公司工作。1926年10月16日，他被调往该公司马德里分公司。他在此地一直待到1929年11月，随后被派往苏黎世的另一家分公司。在接下来的一年里，他被调往里约热内卢办事处。他在此一直待到1930年7月19日，此时他与该公司断绝了关系。
1931年11月11日，他因对工资不满意（金额为350元）而从上海电话公司辞职。不久之后，他自立门户成为
